violations.text: Opened packages of sliced ham were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Per interview with PIC, ham was likely more than 7 days since they are closed for the season. PIC discarded ham. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - cooler equipment (interior and exterior) - exterior between ice cream unit and slushy unit - interior of pizza oven Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

The floors (behind/under equipment) and walls (below 3 bay sink area) have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. PIC refilled. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (pizza pans) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC placed in 3 bay sink to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025

The presence of small flies are not controlled as evidenced by live small flies. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the pizza cooker have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025
The floors in the 3 bay sink area is in poor repair (broken floor boards). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2025
